clips.title: The story
paras: Delgren the Purifier sends you south from Darkshore into Ashenvale to hunt Ilkrud Magthrull. The orc warlock resides at Fire Scar Shrine, where you are to slay him and recover his tome.

Delgren the Purifier traces the dark cultists at the Tower of Althalaxx to Ilkrud Magthrull, an orc warlock. Ilkrud works from Fire Scar Shrine in southwestern Ashenvale, and Delgren fears his magic could spread through the elven woodlands. He sends you to kill the warlock and take his tome, hoping its contents will reveal his master's designs.

clips.title: Quest text

clips.title: Progress
paras: You look a bit shaken up, friend. Are you well?

clips.title: Completion
paras: It was a grand thing you did today, friend. You should be quite proud of yourself for having faced down a warlock of such power.
Now, let's see what we can learn from Ilkrud's writings.
